_comment: Template for user-defined choreography skills. Copy to user_skills.json (global, beside this file) or <project>/user_skills.json. Composites may only `uses` functions that exist in project_template/scripts/function.py; user primitives may only wrap a function already exported there. Pure metadata — no executables. The loader validates atomically: a malformed file registers nothing. See SKILL.md 'User-defined skills'.

composites.name: my-spiral-bloom
composites.visual_effect: 螺旋波次从中心层层绽放，光波同步扫出
composites.constraints: geo 用 far_assign 求大动作；spiral delays 非零；填满窗口；Z 分层
composites.how_to_choose: 华彩/绽放段且已是中心聚拢队形时
composites.avoid_overuse: 一场一次，避免与 center-out-climax 重复
composites.example: prev = ripple_move(drones, far_assign(prev, geo, min_path_cm=active_min_path_cm(2800)), 2800, ripple_delays(prev, mode='spiral', step_ms=130), colors=palette, gradient_to=cool)
